description:
Activate Stuffy Doll by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Stuffy Doll and Taii Wakeen trigger.
Resolve the Stuffy Doll trigger, dealing 1 damage to the named opponent.
Resolve the Taii Wakeen trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Stuffy Doll.
Repeat.

uses.name: Stuffy Doll
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and with an opponent named
